# kuba

> Lightweight Web Components primitives and custom elements. No framework, no build step — the browser is the runtime and HTML is the API. Components are custom elements configured by attributes; they communicate through native DOM events, wired declaratively in markup with `on="source/event:type/sink"` arcs. Visual elements use the `kb-` prefix, headless ones use `k-`.

Every page below is the markdown this documentation site renders. Translations live under `/pt-br/` and `/es/`; a page missing from a translation falls back to the English original.

- [Quick start](https://t2e1.github.io/kuba/learn/quick-start): a working feature, start to finish

- [Principles](https://t2e1.github.io/kuba/foundations/principles): the rules every element obeys

- [Events and Echo](https://t2e1.github.io/kuba/foundations/events-and-echo): the arc grammar and the dataflow model
